idea-plugin.name: Evergruv
idea-plugin.description: JetBrains adaptation of the Evergruv VS Code color themes, based on Gruvbox Material Dark and Everforest Light from georglauterbach. All credits for the original color themes go to their creator.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• Synced Evergruv Light with recent UI keys and color refinements from Evergruv Dark.
  • Added 1 px backgroundDim borders to tool window headers in both themes.
  • Island compatible
  • Updated some colors to make more readable
